title_en: Domestic Violence: Protection Orders, Residence, Monetary Relief & PWDVA 2005
title_hi: घरेलू हिंसा: संरक्षण आदेश, निवास अधिकार, आर्थिक राहत और डीवी एक्ट 2005

laws.act: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
laws.plain_meaning: Defines domestic violence comprehensively: includes physical abuse, sexual abuse, verbal and emotional abuse, and economic abuse (depriving of financial resources, maintenance, or stridhan).

laws.act: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
laws.plain_meaning: An aggrieved woman, Protection Officer, or service provider may present an application to the Magistrate seeking one or more reliefs under the Act without having to institute divorce proceedings.

laws.act: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
laws.plain_meaning: Magistrate may grant: Protection Orders (s.18 prohibiting acts of violence or communication), Residence Orders (s.19 restraining respondent from dispossessing woman from shared household), Monetary Relief (s.20 for medical expenses and maintenance), Temporary Custody Orders (s.21 for children), and Compensation Orders (s.22 for mental torture).

laws.act: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
laws.plain_meaning: Breach of a protection order or interim protection order by the respondent is a cognizable and non-bailable offence punishable with imprisonment up to 1 year, fine up to Rs. 20,000, or both.

steps.action_en: Ensure immediate physical safety. If in danger, call Women Helpline 181 or Emergency 112. Get treated at a government hospital and obtain an MLC for any injuries.
steps.action_hi: सबसे पहले अपनी और बच्चों की सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करें। आपात स्थिति में महिला हेल्पलाइन 181 या 112 पर कॉल करें। चोट लगने पर सरकारी अस्पताल में मेडिकल (MLC) कराएं।
steps.where: Women Helpline 181 / Nearest Hospital / Police Station

steps.action_en: Contact the designated Protection Officer (PO) appointed in every district under the Women and Child Development Department to prepare a Domestic Incident Report (DIR) in Form I.
steps.action_hi: जिले के महिला एवं बाल विकास विभाग में तैनात प्रोटेक्शन ऑफिसर से मिलें और घरेलू घटना रिपोर्ट (DIR) दर्ज करवाएं।
steps.where: Office of the Protection Officer / District WCD Office / One Stop Centre (Sakhi Centre)
steps.deadline_or_limitation: As soon as possible after incident

steps.action_en: File an application under Section 12 PWDVA before the Judicial Magistrate First Class / Metropolitan Magistrate seeking urgent ex-parte interim protection orders under Section 23.
steps.action_hi: मजिस्ट्रेट की अदालत में धारा 12 के तहत याचिका दायर करें और धारा 23 के तहत तुरंत अंतरिम सुरक्षा आदेश की मांग करें।
steps.where: Court of Judicial Magistrate First Class (JMFC) / Mahila Court
steps.deadline_or_limitation: No strict limitation, but continuous domestic relationship or recent eviction must be shown
documents_needed: Petition under Section 12 in Form II supported by affidavit (Form III)
Domestic Incident Report (DIR) copy from Protection Officer
Marriage proof and residence proof in shared household
Income affidavit (in format prescribed by Supreme Court in Rajnesh v. Neha)
Stridhan list and bills (if claiming recovery)

steps.action_en: If in-laws attempt to throw the woman out of the house, inform Protection Officer and police immediately for enforcement of residence order under Section 19.
steps.action_hi: ससुराल पक्ष द्वारा घर से निकालने की कोशिश पर धारा 19 के निवास आदेश के तहत पुलिस और प्रोटेक्शन ऑफिसर की सहायता लें।

helplines.name: Women Helpline (All India)
helplines.description: 24x7 toll-free helpline providing emergency response, counseling, and shelter referrals

helplines.name: One Stop Centre (Sakhi Centre)
helplines.description: Integrated medical, legal, counseling, and temporary shelter under one roof

helplines.name: NALSA Free Legal Aid Helpline
helplines.description: Zero-fee court representation for all women regardless of income

free_legal_aid.eligible: All women are unconditionally entitled to free legal aid under Section 12(c) of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, irrespective of their financial status.
free_legal_aid.how_to_apply: Approach the DLSA front office at the District Court or Sakhi One Stop Centre. DLSA assigns a designated legal aid advocate for drafting, filing, and arguing the PWDVA petition without any court fees or lawyer fees.

when_to_see_a_lawyer: To draft the comprehensive Section 12 petition, affidavit of assets and liabilities per Rajnesh v. Neha, and urgent stay on dispossession
When child custody is contested or children are forcibly withheld by the husband/in-laws
When simultaneous criminal proceedings (BNS s.85/86 cruelty, dowry) or maintenance suits are needed
